diff: +- **own evidence** — of a premise: every declaration that uses the premise directly and either sits in a SaltCheck module (a Salt witness), or concludes the premise negated (a refutation), or concludes the premise itself, alone or under existential binders, with no hypothesis naming it -- bare (a witness) or under other hypotheses (a sufficient condition or a discharge); the premise's projections and constructors are its own names and leave the use-graph with it *(the author's ruling (R254)(4) and the author's word at b644; the rule in relay tools/b644_record.py, E1-E3)*

+- **HINGE** — a premise of one of the five programme statuses (OPEN, CITED, DISCHARGED, WITNESSED, REFUTED-BY-COMPUTATION) whose consumers lie in more than one kernel, or in more than one chain within a kernel, the chains taken after the premise's own evidence (the entry above) is removed from the use-graph; a premise of status DOMAIN, a Mathlib predicate restricting a quantified variable, is printed with its chains and is not a hinge *(the author's ruling (R254)(4); it supersedes the HINGE entry of 2026-10-08 (the author's ruling (R253)(5)(b)), in force from 2026-10-09)*
